During the [[Great Galactic War]], [[Darth Immern]] commanded his '''personal cruiser''' as part of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Both Immern and his cruiser were destroyed in the [[First Battle of Bothawui]].
